From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + Proposed Pilot Charter for AcuTeCare — next steps and kickoff asks

Hi Marta / Samir,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clear articulation of the problem and the constraints. Quick recap so we're aligned and so we can get the pilot scheduled: 

Top pain points you described:
- High time spent triaging inbound patient messages (average 8–12 minutes per record).
- Extraction errors for key fields (medication, next-steps) when notes are noisy / shorthand.
- Current vendor latency prevents near-real-time assistant in the patient portal.

Pilot goals (proposed):
1) Extraction accuracy: reach >= 90% F1 on our agreed prompt/eval set for Medication + Follow-up fields.
2) Latency: p95 inference < 350ms for 256-token requests in your staging region.
3) Cost: target incremental token cost <= $0.003/token across typical prompt mix.
4) Integration: end-to-end demo in your staging environment with KV cache enabled and prefix caching for repeat prompts.

Proposed pilot scope (2-week sprint):
- Week 0 (prep): access & IAM, sample dataset ingest (1000 de-identified notes), initial prompt tuning.
- Week 1: run evals, iterate prompt set, baseline metrics capture.
- Week 2: ramp to 5-10 TPS in staging, handoff demo + success criteria signoff.

Owners and roles:
- Redwood: Irene Choi (AE) — program lead; Karthik Iyer (Solutions Engineer) — infra & access; Priyom Das (CS) — success + evals.
- AcuTeCare: Marta Ruiz — product owner; Samir Patel — engineering lead; Jeff Lin — security/infra contact.

Access asks (required prior to Week 0):
- Staging AWS account ID and an IAM role we can assume (see attached access_checklist_acutecare.xlsx).
- Sample of 1k de-identified notes (S3 link or upload).
- Security contact to complete SOC2 and encryption questions (we can provide a short questionnaire).

Attachments: pilot_charter_acutecare_v1.pdf (charter + success metrics), access_checklist_acutecare.xlsx (IAM checklist).

Suggested next steps (please confirm):
- You confirm security contact and share preferred kickoff slots (we propose Mon 10 Aug or Tue 11 Aug).
- We send updated charter (v1.1) incorporating any compliance constraints.

If that all looks correct I'll loop in Karthik and Priyom and put a tentative 45-minute kickoff on the calendar.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0119

Thanks for the crisp recap — this aligns with our internal view. A few clarifying items from our compliance and infra teams before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Security evidence: Can you share SOC 2 type II report and a brief note on encryption at rest keys (customer-managed KMS support)? Our security lead (Jeff Lin) will want to review.
2) Data retention: For the pilot we need Redwood to guarantee a 30-day retention max for any transient sample data; can you confirm deletion flow?
3) On-prem possibility: We prefer cloud staging but want to understand if a private deployment (VPC/on-prem connector) is an option if we move beyond pilot.

Jeff (cc'd) — can you confirm the best contact for an IAM role creation and whether S3 uploads are preferred or granting temporary access?

We're good to move forward provided SOC2 evidence + a short security Q&A. Tentatively ok for Mon 10 Aug kickoff — I'll confirm by EOD.

Hi Marta / Samir — thanks, and great questions. Short answers here and next steps below.

Security & compliance:
- SOC 2 Type II: yes, happy to share. Attaching a redacted SOC2 summary and a link to our security questionnaire (see related links).
- Encryption: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS) for Private deployments; for hosted pilots we can provide envelope encryption and discuss KMS integration if you move to Dedicated/Private.
- Data deletion: we support automated purge on pilot completion and can configure a 30-day retention policy for the pilot dataset; we'll include the deletion script in the charter.

On-prem / Private options:
- Private deployment is an available option if you require VPC or on-prem later; for a short pilot we recommend hosted staging to iterate quickly but we'll document the path and prerequisites.

Next steps / owners (action items):
- AcuTeCare: confirm Jeff as security/infra contact and provide an IAM role or S3 upload by Fri 7 Aug. (AcuTeCare)
- Redwood: Karthik to provision staging sandbox and guide IAM role setup. (Karthik)
- Redwood: Priyom to prepare the eval prompt set and baseline scoring harness. (Priyom)
- Scheduling: propose Tue 10 Aug 10:00–10:45 PT for kickoff; Marta to confirm.

I've attached an updated charter with a short section on retention & encryption (pilot_charter_acutecare_v1_1.pdf). Karthik — can you pick up the infra checklist and ping Jeff directly for role details?

Thanks — looping in a few technical details so AcuTeCare can prepare before the kickoff: 

Minimal infra checklist for Week 0 (short checklist):
- Provide a staging AWS account ID and create a cross-account role with the following policies: S3ReadOnlyForPilot, AssumeRoleForRedwoodSandbox. Example trust policy snippet attached.
- If you prefer S3 upload: create a signed presigned URL for the sample bundle and email it to infra@redwood.ai.
- Network: allow outbound to redwood inference endpoints (e.g., api.redwood.ai) from staging VPC for burst testing; if you are air-gapped we can run a private on-prem test but that adds ~3 business days to setup.
- Secrets: provide a short-lived token or KMS info for test data decryption; we will not persist keys in cleartext.

Sample IAM command (AWS CLI):
aws iam create-role --role-name RedwoodPilotAcuTeCareRole --assume-role-policy-document file://trust-policy.json

I'll take lead on provisioning the staging sandbox once Jeff shares the role or uploads the sample. Also attaching infra-access-template.txt with the trust policy and minimal policies.
